is_core.description: A boolean describing whether this module is considered 'core'. Defaults to false.

label.description: The label to use in auto-packager comments. Defaults to the id.

category.description: The type of module this module is (i.e. 'core', 'sugar', etc.).

description.description: A brief description of what this module does and provides.

runtime.description: A string indicating what runtime/platform this module is meant to be used with. Defaults to 'Luau'.

requires.description: The ids of other modules that this module is dependant on.

export_types.description: The types that this module publically exports.

export_name.description: The alias to publically export the type as.

export_members.description: The runtime values that this module publically exports.

export_name.description: The alias to publically export the value as.

source.description: The relative path to the Luau module that returns the value.

type.description: The type associated with the export table's concrete type.

external_providers.description: The external providers this module provides. External providers are interfaces for certain aspects of a runtime, such as: a task scheduler, logging and debugging

logger_source.description: The relative path to the Luau module that returns the logger interface.

scheduler_source.description: The relative path to the Luau module that returns the scheduler interface.

debug_source.description: The relative path to the Luau module that returns the debugger interface.

external_consumers.description: The set of external providers that this module requires to function.
